# Brief — The Moon Cheese

Audience: curious adults on a vertical feed.
Tone: deadpan and witty.
Hook options: the moon as a cheese wheel; a village that polishes it.
Must include: a promise with no unsend button.
Avoid: on-screen text and unsupported claims.
Target: 20 seconds.

queries: moon made of green cheese legend

facts.claim: The old village said the moon was made of green cheese.

sources.quote: the moon was said to be made of green cheese

facts.claim: A fox jumped over the lazy dog and the village celebrated for seven days.

sources.quote: a fox jumped over the lazy dog and the village celebrated
